in_marathi.name: Kritavya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Duty bound, obligated
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kritavya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kri’ meaning to do and ‘tavya’ meaning bound or obligated. It signifies a person who is deeply committed to their duties and responsibilities.
